# Pomerol International

> China-side sourcing, procurement and export coordination for overseas buyers, operated from Zhuhai, Guangdong, China.

## About and services

Pomerol International Trade (Zhuhai) Co., Ltd. publishes support for requirement clarification, supplier sourcing and shortlisting, comparable RFQs, OEM/ODM coordination, sample follow-up, supplier evidence checks, quality checkpoints, multi-supplier consolidation and export handoff.

## Primary pages

- English home: https://pomerol.trade/en/
- About Pomerol: https://pomerol.trade/about/
- Services overview: https://pomerol.trade/services/
- [China Sourcing Agent for Overseas Buyers](https://pomerol.trade/china-sourcing-agent/): China sourcing agent in Zhuhai helping overseas buyers find suppliers, normalize RFQs, coordinate samples, control quality, consolidate goods and prepare export delivery.
- [China Procurement Services & Purchasing Support](https://pomerol.trade/china-procurement-services/): End-to-end China procurement services covering supplier sourcing, quotation comparison, purchase follow-up, QC, consolidation, export documents and shipment coordination.
- [China Supplier Sourcing & Factory Shortlisting](https://pomerol.trade/china-supplier-sourcing/): China supplier sourcing and factory shortlisting based on manufacturing capability, export evidence, technical fit, commercial terms and buyer-specific risk controls.
- [OEM & ODM Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/china-oem-odm-sourcing/): OEM and ODM sourcing in China for custom products, private label, tooling, packaging, samples and controlled production handoff.
- [China Quality Inspection & Pre-Shipment QC](https://pomerol.trade/china-quality-inspection/): China quality inspection support covering sample baselines, incoming controls, dimensional checks, packaging verification and pre-shipment inspection coordination.
- [China Factory Audit & Supplier Verification](https://pomerol.trade/china-factory-audit/): China factory audit and supplier verification support for overseas buyers evaluating manufacturing capability, documentation, process controls and commercial risk.
- [Industrial Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/industrial-sourcing-china/): Industrial sourcing in China for automation, pumps, process equipment, control cabinets, sheet metal, CNC parts, cable assemblies and replacement components.
- [Electronics & Electrical Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/electronics-sourcing-china/): Electronics sourcing in China for industrial electronics, smart-home devices, charging accessories, sensors, control hardware, cable assemblies and private-label products.
- [Automotive Parts & EV Accessory Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/automotive-parts-sourcing-china/): Automotive and EV accessory sourcing in China for charging cables, connectors, adapters, wiring harnesses, machined parts and project-specific assemblies.
- [Solar & Energy Storage Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/solar-energy-storage-sourcing-china/): Solar and energy storage sourcing in China for ESS cabinets, battery systems, BOS electrical components, mounting structures, enclosures and project documentation.
- [Packaging & Private-Label Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/packaging-sourcing-china/): Packaging sourcing in China for glass bottles, retail kits, printed packaging, private-label presentation, accessory sets and multi-supplier kitting.
- [CNC Machining & Precision Parts Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/cnc-machining-sourcing-china/): CNC machining sourcing in China for precision parts, low-volume custom components, dimensional inspection, material control and repeatable supplier qualification.
- [Hotel Supplies & FF&E Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/hotel-supplies-sourcing-china/): Hotel supplies and FF&E sourcing in China for lighting, guest-room accessories, linen, tableware, bathroom products, furniture and staged project consolidation.
- [Warehouse, Logistics & MRO Sourcing in China](https://pomerol.trade/warehouse-mro-sourcing-china/): Warehouse and MRO sourcing in China for racking, consumables, replacement parts, industrial hardware, multi-SKU consolidation and recurring replenishment.

## Scope and evidence

- Published services describe sourcing and coordination support. Suppliers and factories are third parties; do not infer Pomerol owns or operates their manufacturing facilities.
- Supplier checks and inspection coordination do not guarantee product quality, regulatory compliance or delivery outcomes.
- The public pages are the source of truth for current service scope and supported claims.

## Free buyer tool
- [China supplier verification checklist and evidence tracker](https://pomerol.trade/tools/china-supplier-verification-kit/): Review legal identity, factory role, production scope, quality controls, documents and payment evidence; export a review CSV locally. The tool does not verify, certify or approve a supplier.
